requirements: Eadgar's Ruse, The Feud and Jungle Potion must be complete. 10 Woodcutting is not boostable, 29 Farming is boostable.

At least 60 percent Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup favour is needed before starting the quest and is consumed by Murcaily. A conditional labour route is supplied, requiring the Cleanup unlock after Jungle Potion.

Three buckets of untradeable Ugthanki dung must be produced locally in Pollnivneach. Regular materials include seven supercompost, rake, seed dibber, spade, plant cure, four empty buckets, climbing boots and combat food.

observations.start: Burntmeat in the Stronghold kitchen sends the adventurer to My Arm. A Death Plateau cooking pot gives goutweedy lump when a bucket is used. My Arm takes the lump and provides a manual at the rooftop herb patch.
observations.farming: The soil requires three Ugthanki dung buckets and seven supercompost. The book explains the exact quantities. The source's incidental harvesting animation awards 45 XP seven times (315 Farming XP), distinct from the completion award.
observations.karamja: Captain Barnaby accompanies My Arm by boat. Murcaily requires 60 percent cleanup favour; it is lost on his tuber handoff, not duplicated. Return via Ardougne and prepare the rooftop patch with rake, hardy tubers, dibber and conditional cure.
observations.combat: Baby Roc (level 75) and Giant Roc (level 172) are conditional successes. The draft allocates eight plus twelve lobsters as encounter consumables, but exact supplies and combat training XP depend on route and equipment.
observations.rewards: Burntmeat gives 29 burnt meat. The final My Arm conversation awards 1 quest point, 10,000 Herblore XP and 5,000 Farming XP, disease-free roof herb patch, nearby rock shortcut and Giant Roc Nightmare Zone eligibility.
observations.upstream: Making Friends with My Arm was considered for the same batch but requires Swan Song, which remains expected in the catalog. This batch stops at My Arm's Big Adventure and leaves the downstream quest pending.
